decisions.reason: As a recently launched safety shoe line in the firm’s core market, management is likely to continue it because sunk development and launch costs are fresh and any weak early uptake can still be framed as temporary.

The comfort insole is less prominently committed than headline products, but the firm has already invested in the work-shoe platform and is likely to persist rather than admit a quick reversal after launch.

The supportive insole faces some risk because it is one of several similar insole offers, yet escalation of commitment makes an early withdrawal unlikely while management can still justify giving it more time.
The ergonomic safety shoe series received its own webpage, signaling visible public commitment in a strategically central category, which strongly lowers the chance of an early drop.

Firefighter and rescue boots are a more specialized niche, but they still fit the protective-footwear business and a large established German manufacturer would likely continue after initial investment rather than retreat immediately.
Because the moulded insole was shown on the home page, management has made a very visible commitment and is therefore likely to keep backing it despite any uncertain first-year results.
